title: Document Loaders Module
summary: This module provides interfaces and implementations for loading documents from various sources. It defines a base loader for general document handling and a specific loader for retrieving examples from LangSmith datasets.

nodes.label: Define Document Loader Interface
nodes.title: Base Document Loader
nodes.description: Provides a foundational abstract interface for all document loaders, defining methods for loading and lazily loading documents. It also includes a utility method for loading and splitting documents using a text splitter.

nodes.label: Load LangSmith Dataset Examples
nodes.title: LangSmith Dataset Loader
nodes.description: Loads examples from LangSmith datasets, converting them into Document objects. It extracts example inputs as page content and stores full example details in metadata, supporting filtering and content formatting.

nodes.label: Convert Data to String
nodes.title: Data Stringifier Utility
nodes.description: A utility function that converts various data types (strings, dictionaries) into a string representation, primarily used for formatting content within documents.

nodes.label: Split Text into Chunks
nodes.title: Text Splitter
nodes.description: An external component responsible for breaking down large text documents into smaller, manageable chunks, often used before processing or indexing.

nodes.label: Interact with LangSmith API
nodes.title: LangSmith API Client
nodes.description: An external client used to communicate with the LangSmith platform, enabling the retrieval of dataset examples and related metadata.

nodes.label: Represent Loaded Data
nodes.title: Document Object
nodes.description: The standard data structure used to represent loaded content, typically containing the main textual content (page_content) and a dictionary of associated metadata.

groups.label: Core Interfaces
groups.title: Core Document Loader Interfaces
groups.description: Defines the fundamental abstract interfaces for all document loading operations, ensuring consistency across different data sources.

groups.label: Specific Loaders
groups.title: Specialized Document Loaders
groups.description: Implementations of document loaders tailored for specific data sources, such as LangSmith datasets, to extract and format content.

groups.label: Utilities
groups.title: Helper Functions
groups.description: Auxiliary functions that support the main document loading process, providing essential capabilities like data formatting and conversion for consistent output.
